scoringRule.correctness: 0-2 researcher score for identifying the substantive issue without inventing evidence
scoringRule.traceability: 0-2 score for exact immutable artifact/source locators and visible coverage limits
scoringRule.checkRecall: fraction of expected deterministic or researcher checks explicitly attempted
scoringRule.comparisonRule: Run recipe, plain Workspace, and ordinary Codex variants with the same files, model, effort, and access. Do not report a percentage improvement without all three records.
